# Integration bundles

Canonical source snapshot:

`0.9.0-rc.2`.

Release builds render the exact tag version into every package.

All thin packages start `corr mcp serve` over local stdio and require a
separately installed Corresync CLI. They contain no accounts, credentials,
mailbox data, or private configuration. No package enables automatic
approval.

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
| Surface | Native package | Mode | Agent Skill | Local MCP | Limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codex` | `plugin` | `thin` | yes | yes | Local Codex sessions only; hosted ChatGPT cannot reach this stdio server. |
| `claude-code` | `shared-claude-plugin` | `thin` | yes | yes | Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and VS Code must run where corr is installed. |
| `gemini-cli` | `extension` | `thin` | yes | yes | Local Gemini CLI only; the extension does not bundle corr. |
| `kiro` | `power` | `thin` | yes | yes | Local Kiro IDE only; Kiro Web and remote sandboxes are unsupported. |
| `claude-desktop` | `mcpb` | `self-contained` | — | yes | The MCPB contains release binaries but never contains configured accounts or authentication state. |
<!-- markdownlint-enable MD013 -->

Config-only metadata is generated for:

- `cursor`
- `windsurf`
- `opencode`
- `cline`
- `roo-code`
- `zed`
- `goose`
- `qwen-code`
- `qoder`
- `kimi-code`

A lifecycle adapter must translate the neutral launch and Skill metadata into
each host's documented schema; the metadata is not presented as a native
package.
